Hi Mark / Susan,

Thanks again for the time on the call yesterday — we appreciated the chance to learn more about WillowBank's roadmap for customer self-service and regulatory reporting. As discussed, our next step is a short sponsor-level demo tailored for your CIO and VP of Product so they can validate fit with your latency and audit requirements.

Could you confirm whether Mark (CIO) intends to join, and whether you have a preferred VP or director-level attendee? We can keep this to 30 minutes and focus on: 1) security/data handling, 2) performance at scale, and 3) integration pattern for your ETL.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue 11 May: 9:30–10:00 or 16:00–16:30
- Wed 12 May: 11:00–11:30

I've attached a short mutual action plan and a draft agenda for the sponsor demo — happy to adjust. Rafael will lead the demo with a short intro from me.

Best,
